summary_en: 160,000 shares (1.82% of shares outstanding), ¥100M ceiling. Open-market acquisition via TSE. Period: 19 Jun–31 Jul 2026. Stated rationale: shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Artiza Networks announced on 17 June 2026 that its board has authorized the acquisition of up to 160,000 treasury shares (1.82% of shares outstanding, calculated as 160,000 ÷ 8,779,600) for a maximum expenditure of ¥100 million. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 19 June and 31 July 2026. The stated purpose is to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency. At the authorization date, the company held 782,400 treasury shares against 8,779,600 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
